meta_title: J Peat Plastering | Expert Plasterer Leeds
meta_description: J Peat Plastering Services in Leeds delivers high-quality interior and exterior plastering. Fast turnaround, competitive rates. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: Cracked plaster or damp walls? J Peat delivers smooth, professional finishes that last, with a fast turnaround across Leeds.
services_subhead: From interior skimming to external rendering, we handle domestic and commercial projects of all sizes.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional finishes on walls and ceilings. We repair cracks, fill holes, and skim old surfaces to achieve a flawless result ready for decoration.

services.title: Dry Lining & Stud Partition
services.desc: Create new rooms or reconfigure existing spaces with timber or metal stud walls faced in plasterboard. Fast installation with seamless joints.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable, weather-resistant finishes that protect and enhance your property's exterior. We use quality materials suited to Yorkshire's climate.

services.title: Artex Removal & Remedial Work
services.desc: Safe removal of dated Artex coatings followed by professional re-plastering. Ideal for modernising period properties in Horsforth and beyond.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Maintenance
services.desc: Quick fixes for water damage, damp patches, and impact marks. We match existing finishes seamlessly so repairs blend in perfectly.

services.title: Commercial Fit-Outs
services.desc: Experienced in office refurbishments, retail spaces, and new builds. We work to tight schedules and maintain site cleanliness throughout.

about_pullquote: I started plastering because I hated seeing sloppy work. Every job gets my full attention.
about_para_1: J Peat Plastering has been serving Leeds for over 15 years, building a reputation for precision and reliability. Started as a one-man operation in Horsforth, we've grown to handle everything from small domestic repairs to full commercial fit-outs, all while keeping the personal touch that customers value.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, leaving sites clean, and finishing jobs when we say we will. Repeat customers and referrals make up most of our work — a testament to the care we take with every project, whether it's a single-room skim or a multi-week commercial contract.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had J Peat in to skim our lounge and kitchen after replacing windows. Brilliant job — walls are perfectly smooth now. Quick, professional, and tidy. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: External rendering on our 1930s semi was a worry but J Peat made it straightforward. Explained everything upfront, fair pricing, and the finish looks brand new. Very happy.
reviews.author: Catherine L.

reviews.text: Called in an emergency when water damage ruined our bedroom ceiling. J Peat came out within two days, patched it up beautifully and made sure it's ready to paint. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: David M.
